text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with
Admire Vega...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice her eyeing up a claw machine
filled with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about it... Not for me,
though.
For a friend.
choice_data_list: ぬいぐるみが欲しいのか？
ぬいぐるみが欲しいの？

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, never mind. Let's hurry back and
train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She steps forward, but then her head
turns as if
someone yanked on her hair. I
think she's putting
on a front.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? I told you... I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 取ったら気が変わるかも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
